notes: Rule 425 communication (January 29, 2021 press release plus website FAQ) on the proposed merger of DUC into DNP; DNP shareholders do not vote, DUC shareholders vote at a Special Meeting on February 22, 2021. subject_tickers is null: the filing uses 'DNP' and 'DUC' only as defined abbreviations and never prints them as exchange tickers (the only exchange ticker printed is Virtus, NASDAQ: VRTS). exchange_basis nav_for_nav rests on the statement that the conversion ratio is based on each fund's NAV per share; the filing does not use the words 'equal aggregate NAV'. No fixed exchange ratio, outside date or record date is stated. doc_role 'announcement' is used for this Rule 425 press-release/FAQ communication; it is a mid-solicitation communication rather than the first announcement. security_class 'common' is inferred from the merger of fund shares; the filing does not name the class.
